hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.dart$'; then cd "/Users/ian/Dev/Surface Noise Player" && out=$(flutter test 2>&1); last=$(echo "$out" | tail -1); jq -n --arg m "flutter test: $last" '{"systemMessage": $m}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'gh pr create'; then pending=$(grep '^- \[ \]' "/Users/ian/Dev/Surface Noise Player/FEATURES.md" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pending" ]; then jq -n --arg m "FEATURES.md still has pending items — check whether any should be moved to Completed:\n$pending" '{"systemMessage": $m}'; fi; fi
